summary_zh: 本页为绘本标题页，竖排文字显示书名《披着被单的国王》。

page_text_ocr_zh:
森林边上，有个很大的湖泊。
湖泊边上 有棵很高的树，树上有
只很坏很坏的乌鸦。乌鸦和湖里的坏
鳄鱼勾结在一起，只要有谁来湖里游
泳，她就在树上叫：

“湖里掉进一块蛋糕，
味道一定挺好……”

这是乌鸦和鳄鱼约定的暗号。
听到这叫声，坏鳄鱼就会冲出
来，袭击那个游泳者，并把他吃掉。坏
鳄鱼最后会吐出几根骨头，算是给乌
鸦的酬劳。
page_text_en:
On the edge of the forest, there is a big lake.
On the edge of the lake, there is a very tall tree, and on the tree, there is a very bad, very bad crow. The crow and the bad crocodile in the lake have teamed up. Whenever someone comes to swim in the lake, she calls out from the tree:

"A cake has fallen into the lake,
It must taste really good..."

This is the secret signal agreed upon by the crow and the crocodile.
Upon hearing this call, the bad crocodile will rush out,
attack the swimmer, and eat him. Finally, the bad crocodile will spit out a few bones, as payment to the crow.
summary_zh: 本页介绍了森林边湖泊中一只坏乌鸦和坏鳄鱼的阴谋：乌鸦在树上喊‘湖里掉进一块蛋糕’作为暗号，引诱游泳者，鳄鱼则冲出水面将其吃掉，并吐出骨头作为给乌鸦的酬劳。

page_text_ocr_zh:
那天,有只胖胖的
小猪来到湖边,他不知道湖里有鳄鱼,脱下衣服就跳进湖里游泳了。
乌鸦在树上叫着,可是鳄鱼在湖里打瞌睡。乌鸦一连叫了几遍,鳄鱼也没动静。
这时,有只小河马经过湖边,他瞧见小胖猪在湖里游泳,也跳下了水。可是还没等他拉开架势游泳,小河马的爷爷老河马赶来了,河马爷爷拖起小河马说:“这里有危险!”
这里有危险!
page_text_en:
That day, a chubby little pig came to the lakeside. He didn't know there was a crocodile in the lake, so he took off his clothes and jumped in to swim.
A crow was calling from the tree, but the crocodile was dozing in the lake. The crow called several times, but the crocodile didn't move.
At that moment, a little hippo passed by the lake. He saw the chubby pig swimming and jumped in too. But before he could even start swimming, the little hippo's grandfather, Old Hippo, came running. Old Hippo grabbed the little hippo and said, "There's danger here!"
There's danger here!
summary_zh: 一只胖小猪不知湖中有鳄鱼，脱衣跳入湖中游泳。乌鸦多次呼叫鳄鱼未果，此时小河马也跳入湖中，被其爷爷老河马及时拉住并警告‘这里有危险’。

page_text_ocr_zh:
小河马被爷爷赶回家了。河马爷爷没有看见湖里的小胖猪，他一回头看见了岸边的衣服，以为是小河马留下的，就抱起衣服回家了。
小胖猪游得正开心的时候，坏乌鸦又大声叫了起来：“湖里掉进一块蛋糕，不吃马上跑掉……”
鳄鱼打完瞌睡，乌鸦这一声怪叫，让他瞧见了正在游泳的小胖猪，
鳄鱼猛地游了过来。
这时，小胖猪游累了，他正想上岸，回头看见一条鳄鱼追来，连忙冲上了岸。再一看，他留在湖边的衣服不见了。
page_text_en:
The little hippo was sent home by his grandfather. The hippo grandfather didn't see the little fat pig in the lake. When he turned around, he saw clothes by the shore and thought they were left by the little hippo, so he picked them up and went home.
While the little fat pig was swimming happily, the bad crow shouted loudly again: "A cake has fallen into the lake! Don't eat it, run away immediately..."
After finishing his nap, the crocodile heard the crow's strange cry and spotted the little fat pig swimming.
The crocodile swam over fiercely.
At that moment, the little fat pig was tired from swimming and was about to get ashore. He turned around and saw a crocodile chasing him, so he hurriedly rushed onto the shore. Then he looked again and saw that his clothes left by the lake were gone.
summary_zh: 小胖猪在湖中游泳时，坏乌鸦再次发出暗号，鳄鱼闻声游来。小胖猪游累上岸，发现自己的衣服不见了，而鳄鱼正从水中冲出。

page_text_ocr_zh:
惊慌失措的小胖猪逃进湖边的树林，伤心地大哭了起来。这时，有四只小青蛙闻声赶来，问小胖猪为什么哭。
小胖猪把自己在湖里游泳，差点儿被坏鳄鱼吃掉的事告诉了小青蛙。
他还说，自己放在湖边的衣服也丢了，他光着身子没法回家。

四只小青蛙说小胖猪胆子太大了，他们把鳄鱼和乌鸦勾结在一起害人的事告诉了小胖猪。
那只最小的青蛙还说：“自从坏鳄鱼和乌鸦来到这里，我们再也没法下湖游泳，我都快忘记怎么游泳了！”

这时，那只最大的青蛙说：“我们还是帮小胖猪想想办法，让他能回家吧！”
page_text_en:
The panicked little pig ran into the woods by the lake and cried sadly. At that moment, four little frogs came running, asking the little pig why he was crying.

The little pig told the frogs about swimming in the lake and almost being eaten by the bad crocodile.

He also said that his clothes, which he had left by the lake, were gone, and he couldn’t go home naked.

The four little frogs said the little pig was too brave, and they told him about the crocodile and the crow conspiring to harm others.

The smallest frog added, “Ever since the bad crocodile and the crow came here, we can’t swim in the lake anymore. I’ve almost forgotten how to swim!”

At that moment, the biggest frog said, “Let’s think of a way to help the little pig get home!”
summary_zh: 小胖猪在湖边游泳后衣服被偷，光着身子哭泣，四只小青蛙赶来安慰并告知湖中有鳄鱼和乌鸦勾结害人，最小的青蛙表示他们已无法安全游泳，最大的青蛙提议帮助小胖猪回家。

page_text_ocr_zh:
小胖猪说他家离这儿不远，他请四只小青蛙帮他回家拿衣服。
不一会儿，四只小青蛙赶来了，说在小胖猪家里没找到衣服，只好把他家床上的被单拿来了。
小胖猪这才想起，自己的衣服正晒在屋前的树丛里，他说：“没关系，被单也行！”就把被单披在身上了。
那只最小的青蛙，还带来了小胖猪家一只漂亮的小篮子，他以为那是小胖猪的帽子。小青蛙把小篮子扣在了小胖猪的头上。
小胖猪走回家去，四只小青蛙紧跟在他后面，提着长被单的两只角，不让它们拖在泥地上。
page_text_en:
The little fat pig said his home wasn't far away, so he asked four little frogs to help him go back and get his clothes.
After a while, the four little frogs arrived and said they couldn't find his clothes at his house, so they brought his bedsheet instead.
The little fat pig then remembered his clothes were hanging in the bushes in front of his house. He said, "It's okay, a bedsheet will do!" and put it over himself.
The smallest frog also brought a pretty little basket from the pig's house, thinking it was the pig's hat. The frog placed the basket on the pig's head.
The little fat pig walked home, and the four little frogs followed closely behind, holding the two corners of the long bedsheet so it wouldn't drag on the muddy ground.
summary_zh: 小胖猪的衣服被偷后，四只小青蛙帮忙找衣服未果，便拿来了被单和小篮子。小胖猪披着被单、戴着小篮子回家，小青蛙们跟在后面帮忙提着被单，防止拖在地上弄脏。

page_text_ocr_zh:
正在这时，一个山妖来到湖边钓鱼。他看见在湖边走着的小胖猪，以为自己碰见了一位国王，一位这里的湖泊之王——

这位“湖泊之王”戴着漂亮的王冠，披着很威风的大斗篷，身后还有四位侍从紧跟着。

山妖非常惊奇，他十分恭敬地说：
“尊敬的湖泊之王，非常荣幸见到您，如果您有什么吩咐，我乐意照着去办！”
page_text_en:
Just then, a mountain demon came to the lakeside to fish. He saw the little fat pig walking by the lake and thought he had met a king, the king of this lake—

This 'King of the Lake' wore a beautiful crown, draped in a very imposing large cloak, with four attendants following closely behind.

The mountain demon was very surprised. He spoke with great respect: 
"Your Majesty, King of the Lake, it is a great honor to meet you. If you have any requests, I would be happy to carry them out!"
summary_zh: 山妖在湖边钓鱼时，看到披着被单、戴着篮子的小胖猪，误以为他是威风的‘湖泊之王’，并恭敬地向他请示愿意效劳。

page_text_ocr_zh:
小胖猪扶了扶头上的“王冠”，压低嗓门说：“祝你交好运，我会让你钓到好东西的。”
小胖猪抬头望着树上继续说：“山妖啊，请用这树上的乌鸦当钓饵，你就会大有所获。请带着你从湖里钓到的好东西，回你的山洞慢慢享用吧！”
“是，我乐于遵命！”
山妖纵身一跳，就逮到了树上的坏乌鸦，他把坏乌鸦放在鱼钩上当钓饵，抛进了大湖里。
page_text_en:
The little fat pig adjusted the 'crown' on his head and whispered, "May you have good luck. I'll make sure you catch something good."
Looking up at the tree, the little fat pig continued, "Mountain demon, please use this crow on the tree as bait. You'll have a great catch. Take the good things you catch from the lake back to your cave and enjoy them slowly!"
"Yes, I'm happy to obey!"
The mountain demon leaped and caught the bad crow on the tree. He placed the bad crow on the fishing hook as bait and cast it into the big lake.
summary_zh: 小胖猪伪装成‘湖泊之王’，指挥山妖用坏乌鸦作钓饵钓鱼，山妖遵从指令将坏乌鸦抛入湖中。

page_text_ocr_zh:
这时，四只小青蛙一起压低嗓门，学着乌鸦的声音叫了起来：“湖里掉进一块蛋糕，味道一定很好……”
刚才让小胖猪跑了，坏鳄鱼正在懊恼呢。他一听到歌声就猛地蹿了出来，咬住了山妖的钓饵，于是，他的长嘴巴一下子让鱼钩钩住了。
山妖使劲把鳄鱼拽上了岸，他对小胖猪说：“谢谢湖泊之王的指点，这条皮厚厚的怪鱼，够我吃上好一阵子了！”
山妖拖着水淋淋的鳄鱼走远了。
Wow
page_text_en:
At this moment, four little frogs lowered their voices together and imitated the crow's voice, calling out: "A cake fell into the lake, it must taste delicious..."
Just now, the bad crocodile had let the little fat pig escape. He was feeling annoyed. As soon as he heard the song, he suddenly lunged out, bit the mountain demon's bait, and thus, his long mouth was instantly hooked.
The mountain demon pulled the crocodile ashore with great effort. He said to the little fat pig, "Thank you, King of the Lake, for your guidance. This thick-skinned monster fish is enough for me to eat for a long time!"
The mountain demon dragged the wet crocodile away.
Wow
summary_zh: 四只小青蛙模仿乌鸦的声音引诱鳄鱼上钩，鳄鱼咬住山妖的鱼饵被钩住，山妖将其拖上岸并感谢小胖猪的‘指点’，随后拖着鳄鱼离开，小胖猪则欢呼庆祝。

page_text_ocr_zh:
这时，河马爷爷抱着小胖猪的衣服又来到湖边，他的身后跟着小河马。
河马爷爷说：“小胖猪，对不起！刚才我抱走了你的衣服，你可不能在这儿游泳啊……”
“放心游吧！坏鳄鱼和坏乌鸦完蛋了！”四只小青蛙把刚才发生的事告诉了河马爷爷，大家可高兴了。
四只小青蛙、小胖猪和小河马接连跳进湖里，湖面激起一阵又一阵的水花……
“扑通、扑通、扑通……”
page_text_en:
At this moment, Grandpa Hippo, carrying Little Fat Pig's clothes, came back to the lakeside, followed by Little Hippo.
Grandpa Hippo said, "Little Fat Pig, I'm sorry! I just took your clothes, you can't swim here..."
"Swim with peace of mind! The bad crocodile and the bad crow are finished!" The four little frogs told Grandpa Hippo what had just happened, and everyone was very happy.
The four little frogs, Little Fat Pig, and Little Hippo jumped into the lake one after another, creating wave after wave of splashes...
"Plop, plop, plop..."
summary_zh: 河马爷爷带着小胖猪的衣服回到湖边，向小胖猪道歉并阻止他游泳。四只小青蛙告知坏鳄鱼和坏乌鸦已被制服，大家高兴地跳入湖中游泳，湖面溅起阵阵水花。

page_text_ocr_zh:
河马爷爷呢，坐在湖边帮他们
看衣服。他看着六个小伙伴在湖里
快活地扑腾着，觉得比自己下湖还高兴……
page_text_en:
Where is Grandpa Hippo? He's sitting by the lake, helping them
watch their clothes. He watches the six little companions splashing happily in the lake, feeling even more delighted than if he had gone swimming himself...
summary_zh: 河马爷爷坐在湖边帮大家看衣服，看着六个小伙伴在湖里快乐地游泳，感到比自己下水还要高兴。
